verdicts.reason: A: the headline stacks well on two lines and the hierarchy reads cleanly. But the subtitle is jammed against 'Saturday 21 June', there is dead space left of the phone, and the placeholder box sits right beside the 'Reserve a spot' line, almost touching it. B: the one-line headline nearly runs into the canvas edges. The footer also runs edge to edge.
